description: The economy tracker's catalogue: Maldives Monetary Authority statistical series grouped by theme, each with its latest figure and year-on-year change. Open one with get_tracker_series. Says so plainly if the tracker database is unavailable. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

theme.description: Theme id: growth, tourism, prices, fiscal, money or external.

name: list_tracker_series

available.description: False when the tracker database could not be reached; the other fields are then absent.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

title: List economy tracker series
